prompt: The camera moves steadily forward along a narrow, snow-covered trail winding through the dense forest of Mardi Himal Trail in Kaski, Nepal. The path is flanked by tall trees whose branches are heavy with snow, casting long shadows across the ground as the sun sets, bathing the scene in a warm, golden light that contrasts sharply with the cool white of the snow. The camera pans slightly to the left, revealing a rocky outcrop partially covered in snow, before returning to the center of the trail. As the camera continues its forward motion, it captures the intricate details of the snowy landscape, from the delicate snowflakes falling gently from the sky to the rugged texture of the rocks and tree trunks. The camera angle remains at eye level, providing an immersive first-person perspective of the journey. The surrounding environment is serene and untouched, with no signs of human presence, emphasizing the solitude and tranquility of the scene. The soft crunch of snow underfoot adds a subtle auditory element to the visual experience, enhancing the sense of being enveloped in nature's quiet beauty. As the camera progresses, the trail curves gently to the right, leading deeper into the forest, where the interplay of light and shadow creates a mesmerizing dance of warmth and cold, capturing the essence of a snowy sunset in the heart of the mountains.
